annotations.title: Get the link that deletes a team

description: Answers `url`, the Billing page of the team with Delete Team open, where an admin, signed in, deletes the team with its sites, runs, reports, share links, and invitations, and the API keys and run email settings of members who aren't on another team. This ends its subscription and removes its members. Only an admin gets the link, so a member gets 403.
name: teamDeletionLink
title: Get the link that deletes a team
